spec.scene: A warm wooden balcony floor bathed in amber sunlight features a small round patio table at the center. An oversized rustic peach galette sits on a ceramic plate, sliced and glistening with golden fruit. A smartphone props upright against a water glass, its screen glowing softly. To the left, a canvas market tote spills giant leafy purple carrots and a round sourdough loaf onto the floorboards. At the back edge, a simple black metal railing overlooks a warm golden glow.
spec.title: Golden Hour Galette
spec.caption: Baked an ugly, delicious galette with Mom and ate it at sunset.
